findings.basis: Exact original final real source-proof counterexample refuses at the new end-of-recheck live HEAD comparison. Positive tracked-derived and later historical validation remain valid; changed owner proof refuses. Additional later native-byte-read fault also refuses.
findings.limits: Resolution of this publisher diagnostic only; does not resolve the separate source freshness lineage or approve campaign source payloads.

findings.title: Final live source check does not retain a coherent Git index through staged-entry verification
findings.independent_confirmation: Read the full actual source check, root reproduction script and all four saved fixture states; inspected actual Git staged blobs and unchanged installed bytes/HEAD; reran actual frozen completed verification. This is independent exact readback, not a second injection-lifecycle run.
findings.reproduction: Run provenance/probe_index_window.py under the recorded Python against frozen7d. Native apply and receipt helper functions are not replaced. A sys.setprofile hook stages actual installed accepted owner endpoints on entry to the real finish_receipt. Once the receipt is flushed complete, it schedules a real git hash-object/update-index operation either after the actual cached diff returns, or after actual cat-file returns. Hooks neither substitute results nor change native code. Both late modes complete and verify historically while the recorded real index differs from approved scope/bytes.
locators: src/mediaingredientmech/curate/campaign_owner_apply.py:1338-1339 (finish_receipt final recheck followed by complete return)
findings.bounded_fix: Bind the index state used for cached enumeration and stage/blob validation through the end of each live check, and refuse concurrent changes before success. Use a coherent stage/path/mode/blob snapshot or equivalent native-safe verification; account for legitimate Git stat-cache refresh instead of blindly prohibiting every index-file metadata change. Preserve legitimate installed endpoint staging between boundaries, literal paths, and historical completed verification without a current-index lock. Do not merely add a HEAD check, which cannot see index-only changes.
required_tests: Actual final-recheck index addition after cached enumeration must refuse and leave honest failed recovery evidence.
Actual planned-owner index substitution after its genuine blob read must refuse; working bytes/HEAD remain unchanged to isolate index freshness.
Clean actual installed-endpoint staging and later historical validation still pass; initial/postprepare/midflight hidden-index controls remain refused.
Unrelated cached paths, conflict stages, mode mismatch, intent-to-add and premature deletion/accepted payload must remain refused with all original tests intact.

findings.title: Stable Git index flags hide unrelated tracked working-byte drift from the live source scope guard
findings.independent_confirmation: Confirmed separate stable-flag bypass of the live out-of-scope working-byte guard. Unlike SRC001 this needs no race: the caller sets assume-unchanged or skip-worktree and changes an ordinary tracked notes file before apply. Native code does not write that notes file; it fails to refuse the pre-existing unauthorized change. Actual baseline/index bytes and HEAD stay equal while current working bytes differ. Ordinary unflagged drift refuses before output or owner mutation. A coherent index snapshot alone would not fix this case; the live check must reject unsupported flags or verify actual flagged-path working state without silently changing the caller index. Historical completed verification keeps its separate scope.
locators: src/mediaingredientmech/curate/campaign_owner_apply.py:975-989 (cached changed-path enumeration does not enumerate unchanged-blob flagged entries)
findings.bounded_fix: Either explicitly reject unsupported assume-unchanged/skip-worktree state at the relevant live boundaries, or prove the actual working bytes for flagged tracked paths against the accepted baseline with literal path handling, regular-file/path checks and coherent index state. Do not clear flags or rewrite the caller’s index as validation. Preserve legitimate staging of already-installed accepted owner endpoints and later-commit historical verification. Coordinate with the separate final-index consistency correction; a stable index alone is insufficient.
required_tests: The exact two stable postprepare flag modes must refuse before owner mutation/receipt, with ordinary unflagged drift retained as a control.
Cover initially flagged baseline paths, later flag changes, flagged owned endpoints and literal paths without weakening independent source/proof checks.
If flagged state is supported instead of explicitly refused, demonstrate that unchanged real working bytes pass while changed real bytes fail despite identical HEAD/index blobs.
Retain all 301 old source cases and 53 index additions, plus positive installed-endpoint staging and historical completed verification.
